abstract: BACKGROUND: To describe the outcomes of a modified technique for conservative laparoscopic enucleation of ovarian dermoid cyst, placing the ovary in an endobag during enucleation to prevent intraperitoneal spillage. METHODS: Laparoscopic dermoid cyst enucleation was performed in 35 cases of premenopausal patients placing the ovary in an endobag at the beginning of the procedure and removing the cyst from the abdominal cavity by the same endobag. RESULTS: Dermoid cysts with a mean diameter of 6.3 ± 2.7 cm were enucleated and removed laparoscopically 'in a bag' without intra- or postoperative complications. Cyst rupture occurred in 10 cases (28.5%), but evident peritoneal contamination occurred in only 2 (5.7%; 95% confidence interval: 0.7-19.2%), because in 8 patients spillage was contained by the surrounding bag. The mean operative time was 64.6 ± 27 min. No signs or symptoms of peritonitis were observed. The mean postoperative hospitalization was 1.6 ± 1.4 days. Among the 12 infertile patients, 7 spontaneous pregnancies (58%) occurred. CONCLUSIONS: Laparoscopic conservative excision of dermoid cysts placing the ovary in an endobag at the beginning of surgery and removing the cyst by the same bag is a safe and effective approach to reduce intraperitoneal spillage and operative time.

目的：腹腔内への漏出と手術時間を減らすため、卵巣類皮嚢腫の保存的腹腔鏡下摘出術の修正術式の成績を報告する。
方法：閉経前の患者35例に対し、手術開始時に卵巣をエンドバッグに入れ、同じバッグで嚢腫を腹腔外へ取り出す腹腔鏡下卵巣類皮嚢腫摘出術を施行した。
結果：平均直径6.3±2.7 cmの類皮嚢腫を、術中・術後合併症なく「バッグ内で」腹腔鏡下に摘出できた。嚢腫破裂は10例(28.5%)で生じたが、明らかな腹腔内汚染は2例(5.7%；95%信頼区間0.7-19.2%)のみであり、残りの8例ではバッグが漏出を封じ込めた。平均手術時間は64.6±27分であった。腹膜炎の徴候は認めなかった。術後の平均入院期間は1.6±1.4日であった。不妊症の12例中7例(58%)で自然妊娠が成立した。
結論：手術開始時に卵巣をエンドバッグに入れ、同じバッグで嚢腫を摘出する方法は、腹腔内への漏出と手術時間を減らす安全で有効なアプローチである。
